name: Lint, Format, Typecheck, Test, Audit, Publish Check, Build

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096

  format:
    name: Format Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run format:check
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx tsc --noEmit
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096

  audit:
    name: NPM Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm audit --audit-level high
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096

  publish-check:
    name: Publish Dry‑Run
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Dry‑run publish for all packages
        run: |
          find . -name package.json \
            -not -path "./node_modules/*" \
            -not -path "./package.json" \
            -execdir npm publish --dry-run \;
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max_old_space_size=4096
